xna-type.name: ContentBuildLogger
xna-type.summary: Provides methods for reporting informational messages or warnings from content importers and processors.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of ContentBuildLogger.

property.name: LoggerRootDirectory
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: Current name of the base directory or the value to be set.
property.remarks: When building XNA content, all errors are displayed in the Error List Window of Visual Studio. Along with the data that triggered the error, the Error List displays the path and filename where the offending data was encountered. By default, the path of the offending file that is reported in the Error List is always expressed as it relates to the location of the project file that references it. When set, the LoggerRootDirectory property specifies an explicit base path for error reporting that overrides the default operation. All offending files reported in the Error List will be expressed as they relate to the base path set in LoggerRootDirectory .

method.name: GetCurrentFilename
method.summary: Gets the filename currently being processed, for use in warning and error messages.

overload.summary: Gets the filename currently being processed, for use in warning and error messages.

parameters.parameter: Identity of a content item. If specified, GetCurrentFilename uses this value to refine the search. If no value os specified, the current PushFile state is used.

overload.returns: Name of the file being processed.

method.name: LogImportantMessage
method.summary: Outputs a high-priority status message from a content importer or processor.

overload.summary: Outputs a high-priority status message from a content importer or processor.

parameters.parameter: [ ParamArrayAttribute ] Arguments for the reported message.

overload.remarks: Use LogImportantMessage only for important information, because these messages appear in the Output window of Visual Studio. Importers and processors should use this functionality only for unusual or unexpected situations.

method.name: LogMessage
method.summary: Outputs a low priority status message from a content importer or processor.

overload.summary: Outputs a low priority status message from a content importer or processor.

parameters.parameter: [ ParamArrayAttribute ] Arguments for the reported message.

overload.remarks: This message will not usually appear in the Build Output window of Visual Studio, but it can be viewed if the content pipeline is called directly from an MSBuild task.

method.name: LogWarning
method.summary: Outputs a warning message from a content importer or processor.

overload.summary: Outputs a warning message from a content importer or processor.

parameters.parameter: Link to an existing online help topic containing related information.
Identity of the content item that generated the message.
[ ParamArrayAttribute ] Arguments for the reported message.

overload.remarks: Use LogWarning only for important information, because these messages appear in the Error List window of Visual Studio. The message text should indicate what steps need to be taken to correct the problem.

method.name: PopFile
method.summary: Outputs a message indicating that a content asset has completed processing.

overload.summary: Outputs a message indicating that a content asset has completed processing.

method.name: PushFile
method.summary: Outputs a message indicating that a content asset has begun processing.

overload.summary: Outputs a message indicating that a content asset has begun processing.

parameters.parameter: Name of the file containing future messages.
